user.title: Set up FoxESS Globird Energy Observer
user.description: Choose exactly one FoxESS owner: observer, local Modbus, or FoxCloud Mode Scheduler. FoxESS and Tessie automatic control are independent opt-ins. The Safety Lock is ON by default; while it is ON, no hardware writes are allowed.

data.name: Site name

data.grid_import_positive: Grid sensor is positive when importing

data.export_limit_kw: Regulated export limit (kW; 0 if not commissioned)
data.inverter_charge_limit_kw: Inverter charge limit (kW; 0 if not commissioned)
data.inverter_discharge_limit_kw: Inverter discharge limit (kW; 0 if not commissioned)
data.free_charge_full_battery_import_threshol: Full-battery import threshold for Self Use (kWh)
data.foxess_work_mode_entity: FoxESS work-mode selector (required for automatic FoxESS control)
data.foxess_force_charge_power_entity: FoxESS force-charge power number (required for automatic FoxESS control)
data.foxess_force_discharge_power_entity: FoxESS force-discharge power number (required for automatic FoxESS control)
data.ev_charge_limit_entity: EV charge-limit number (optional; reserved for target control)
data.ev_current_limit_entity: EV writable charge-current number (optional; active free-window control)
data.ev_charge_switch_entity: EV charge switch (optional; reserved for target control)
data.non_free_load_following_percent: Other paid-period load-following ceiling (% of inverter)
data.zero_import_threshold_kw: ZEROHERO average import threshold (kWh/hour; contract says 0.03)
data.foxess_control_owner: FoxESS control owner (never mix cloud scheduler and Modbus)
data.automatic_control_enabled: Enable HEO automatic FoxESS control (Local Modbus owner only)
data.ev_automatic_control_enabled: Enable automatic Tessie EV control (commissioned sites only)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure FoxESS Globird Energy Observer
reconfigure.description: Update site mappings, limits, the exclusive FoxESS owner, or the independent FoxESS and Tessie control gates. Safety Lock ON blocks all hardware writes.
